Questions we get every week

Straight answers.

If your question is not here, call +91 94338 34757 — we answer on the phone, not in a call-back queue.

Which insurance policies do you handle?
Health, motor, life, home, fire and burglary, marine and transit, travel, workmen's compensation (WC) and contractors' plant and machinery (CPM). New policies, renewals and claims — all at one desk.
What documents do I need for a health insurance policy?
Aadhaar, PAN, a photograph and any existing policy or medical history. For a family floater, add the same for each member. Bring them once — we keep the file and reuse it at renewal.
Do you help if my claim is rejected?
Yes. Most rejections are a missing document rather than a real refusal. Bring the policy and the rejection letter and we will tell you exactly what to file and where.
Can I renew a motor policy that has already expired?
Usually yes if it lapsed recently, but the No Claim Bonus may be lost and the vehicle may need a fresh inspection. Call with the policy number and we will confirm your case before you pay anything.
Is the consultation really free?
Yes. You pay nothing to sit with us. Our commission comes from the insurer or the lender, and only if a policy or loan is actually issued.
How long does a loan take to come through?
A car or gold loan can move in 24 to 72 hours. A personal or business loan usually takes 3 to 7 working days. Property-backed loans take longer because of the legal and technical check.
Which documents do I need for a personal loan?
Aadhaar, PAN, three to six months of bank statements or salary slips, and address proof. Self-employed applicants also need two years of ITR or business proof.
Do you visit my home or shop?
Yes, within Kolkata and North 24 Parganas. For a policy or a claim we can come to you; for a loan application the bank or NBFC branch visit is arranged with you.
Which areas do you serve?
Lakshminagar, South Dumdum, Motijheel, Dum Dum and Nagerbazar on foot, and the rest of Kolkata and North 24 Parganas by phone, WhatsApp or a visit.
What are your office hours?
Monday to Saturday, 10:00 am to 8:00 pm. Closed on Sunday. You can call or WhatsApp outside those hours and we will reply the next working morning.
